isolation: Fresh Vite process on case-unique loopback origin http://127.0.0.1:4735; origin-scoped local/session storage cannot carry over from other cases.

actions.result: The only personal-area-like page offered Upcoming and Past reservation tabs.
It showed only 'No past reservations yet' and no completed-order detail view.
Only Restaurants, My Reservations, and Browse Restaurants links existed; there was no Personal Center or comment/review-history view.

observations.expected: A personal center exposes comment history, applications/bookings, and completed order details
observations.observed: The app exposes reservation lists only. It has no personal center and no centralized comment history; the empty Past tab provides no completed-order information.

notes: The required combined personal center and comment-history capability is absent.
